	employment_size = generic_tribesmen_employment
	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	build_time = workshop_build_time
	max_levels = 2
	country_potential = {
		has_tribal_government = yes
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			AND = {
				current_date >= 3.1.1
				num_loans = 0
				gold >= { value = monthly_income_total multiply = 24 }
				monthly_balance > { value = monthly_income_total divide = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		always = yes
	}
	location_potential = {
		OR = {
			topography = hills
			topography = plateau
			topography = mountains
		}
		OR = {
			dominant_culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:antq_american_group }
			dominant_culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:antq_mesoamerican_group }
			dominant_culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:antq_andean_group }
		}
	}
	unique_production_methods = {
		antq_trib_america_obsidian_shelter_maintenance = {
			leather = 0.0458
			lumber = 0.0750
			produced = tools
			output = 0.10
			debug_max_profit = rural_profit_margin
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	modifier = {
		local_production_efficiency = 0.01
	}
	construction_demand = antq_small_tribal_craft_construction
	custom_tags = { antq_tribal_building }
}
